svg.title: HTTP fetch lifecycle
svg.desc: Three layers: URL policy and redirect traversal, retry decisions, and one bounded HTTP attempt. Detailed Mermaid source is in docs/DECISIONS.md.

text.tspan: Validated targets. Recoverable attempts. Bounded responses.
Each fetch has a visited set; image-hop promises are shared within the fetcher instance.
Approved: update URL, increment redirects, repeat
Image cache stores promises immediately, including redirect and failure outcomes. Cache hits still follow redirects.
Maximum requests per hop = maxRetries + 1. Each request has a fresh deadline.
Retry-After is evaluated only when another retry is eligible; the delay cap is per wait, not a total fetch deadline.
Start the deadline before GET. No automatic redirects, caller cookies, or caller authentication.
Location present → ok hop with Location; missing → failed: invalid-redirect
206 → failed: http (no retry). Other non-2xx → failed: http.
finish() accepts the first outcome, clears the timer, resolves the hop, releases chunks, and aborts the request.
All terminal outcomes use finish(). Later timeout, error, or end events cannot replace the result.
Redirect status: 301 / 302 / 303 / 307 / 308. Image cap: maxImageBytes. Document / asset cap: maxPageBytes.
Detailed branch logic and editable Mermaid source: docs/DECISIONS.md → HTTP fetch control flow.
